# AirMileX

> Automate mileage tracking by connecting Airtable to mapping providers (Google Maps, OpenRouteService) and generating accurate driving-distance reports.

AirMileX is a web app that reads address columns from an Airtable base, calculates driving distances in batches, writes results back to the base, and produces audit-ready mileage logs. Pricing is one-time credit packs.

- [Home](/): Product overview and sign-in/sign-up.
- [Pricing](/pricing): One-time credit pack — 500 mileage credits for $9.
